title: BACKSCATTER AUDIT — every big fat parse that needs melting
the_problem: Every time we update, it's something. The organism is bloated. We need to grind, abstract, converge, evolve, inject.

index_html.problem: MONOLITH. All rendering, all sensing, all visualization in ONE file.
index_html.action: GRIND: extract into modules. But NOT yet — the monolith IS the organism. It needs to be big. The bloat is elsewhere.

intake_folder.problem: MASSIVE DUPLICATION. 37 copies of 99pi-feed alone (3.5MB each = 130MB). Same data re-ingested every 30 minutes. self-rates, self-manifest, self-heartbeat, self-now all duplicated per timestamp.
intake_folder.action: MELT: keep only LATEST of each feed type. Delete old timestamps. One 99pi. One self-rates. One self-manifest. One self-heartbeat. One per source.

data_folder.includes: intake (249MB) + nutrients + brain + session data + wave data
data_folder.action: MELT intake. Keep nutrients and wave data (they're unique).

art_folder.includes: videos (34MB MP4s), sounds (5MB WAV), images, Desktop/Gaia copies
art_folder.action: CONVERGE: videos could be external links. WAV duplicated in data/ AND art/. Remove dupe.

sporeprint.action: GRIND: search index is enormous. Can be generated on demand, not stored.

html_pages.action: ABSTRACT: many pages are standalone that should be fractal views INTO the HUD. Old eons (index-old-eon, index-sporeprint-eon, index-yggdrasil-eon) can converge.

phase_1_immediate.action: Delete duplicate intake files. Keep only latest per feed source.
phase_1_immediate.risk: Low — old timestamped copies have no value

phase_2_next.action: Remove duplicate WAV. Remove old eon HTML files if they redirect to current.
phase_2_next.risk: Low — content preserved in current eons

phase_3_evolve.action: Move sporeprint search_index to on-demand generation. Externalize video links.

what_stays: index.html (the organism), latest data, unique art, current pages
